weeklyEvents.title: Clash of The Chosen Registration
weeklyEvents.description: The competitive event, Clash of the Chosen, is about to begin! Compete against the strongest players in your Class—only the mightiest will be crowned with the supreme title of the Chosen One.

weeklyEvents.title: Elite Monster
weeklyEvents.description: Elite Monsters respawn every 2 minutes at random locations on field maps. You can also summon Elite Monsters using Dead Branches, available at the shop.

weeklyEvents.title: Mini
weeklyEvents.description: Mini monsters respawn every 30 minutes at random locations on field maps. You can also summon Minis using Bloody Branches, available at the shop.

weeklyEvents.title: Quest Board
weeklyEvents.description: Complete daily commissions to earn Magic Gloves and spin the Adventure Wheel for abundant resources! Commissions have a small chance to refresh with Title Materials as rewards!

weeklyEvents.title: Peer Arena
weeklyEvents.description: Showcase your skills against rivals of the same build, Adventurers!

weeklyEvents.title: Guild Dailies
weeklyEvents.description: Accept daily quests in the Guild Territory to earn Guild Contribution and Adventure Coins upon completion!

weeklyEvents.title: Cat Cargo
weeklyEvents.description: The Cat Paw Caravan posts cargo quests within the Guild, available once daily. Load the required items to complete the quest and earn Guild Contribution upon successful delivery.

weeklyEvents.title: Forgotten Land
weeklyEvents.description: The Forgotten Land connected to the Munak Cave emits a strong undead aura on weekends, offering challengers a wealth of EXP.

weeklyEvents.title: Time Corridor
weeklyEvents.description: Traverse the temporal rift and enter an instance forged from past memories to defeat the monsters within the time shards!

weeklyEvents.title: Monster Extermination
weeklyEvents.description: Effortless idle farming, high drop rates, and rapid progression!

weeklyEvents.title: Brave Trials
weeklyEvents.description: It is said that those who pass the trials are one in a million saviors. Come and try it!

weeklyEvents.title: Rift Raid
weeklyEvents.description: Every Wednesday and Sunday from 10:30 until 5:00 the next day, Rift creatures will respawn every half hour, lasting 30 minutes each time.

weeklyEvents.title: Endless Tower
weeklyEvents.description: Legend has it that this ancient tower was built by the gods in a single day to showcase their might to humanity.

weeklyEvents.title: Time Echoes
weeklyEvents.description: Traverse the temporal rift and enter an instance forged from past memories to defeat the monsters within the time shards!

weeklyEvents.title: Calamity Zone
weeklyEvents.description: A seasonal Party dungeon mode that tests Party composition and strategic choices. Challenge higher difficulties to earn greater settlement rewards.

weeklyEvents.title: Hoppy Quiz
weeklyEvents.description: Oh my! The adorable Lunatic is here with gifts for everyone! He will randomly select 50 lucky players to compete, and the champion will earn 3,280 Starstones and other grand prizes. Players not selected can also bet for rewards! ^w^
weeklyEvents.modalUnlockRequirement:
Server Day 4
Reach Lv.45 to unlock

weeklyEvents.title: Scholar Examination
weeklyEvents.description: The Grand Sage Selection is about to begin across Midgard. Only the wisest adventurers can earn this prestigious honor. The event consists of two phases: the Scholar Examination and the Sage Selection. During the Scholar Examination, you may challenge 10 Sages' quizzes either solo or in a two-player team. The top 50% of players will advance to the Sage Selection for a chance to compete for the title of Grand Sage. The best performers will also share a massive Gold Coin prize pool!
weeklyEvents.unlockRequirement: Unlocks on the 11th day after the server opens
weeklyEvents.modalUnlockRequirement:
Unlocks on the 11th day after the server opens
Reach Lv.30 to unlock

weeklyEvents.title: Sage Selection
weeklyEvents.description: The Grand Sage Selection is about to begin across Midgard. Only the wisest adventurers can earn this prestigious honor. The event consists of two phases: the Scholar Examination and the Sage Selection. During the Sage Selection, you will face 20 questions from the Grand Sage on your own. The quiz ends at 19:30. The competition is an elimination quiz mode. A wrong answer results in elimination, though you may use a Revival Token to revive. The top 3 players will earn the prestigious title of Grand Sage, while the top 10 players (including tied 10th place) will share a massive Gold Coin prize pool!

weeklyEvents.title: Polarity Zone
weeklyEvents.description: Polarity Zone is initiated by the Guild and open to all members. Clearing Star-level difficulties rewards the Guild with substantial loot. Auction dividends from this loot are shared among all participating players.

weeklyEvents.title: Gold Heist
weeklyEvents.description: Every Monday and Friday from 12:00 to 19:30, a Gold Heist will occur on the hour, with each heist lasting 30 minutes. Adventurers from the same Guild can fight solo or team up to intercept the Gold Heist and protect the Guild Fund! The first 6 challenges per week grant full rewards. If all invaders are repelled by 19:00, the Gold Heist Leader will emerge. Defeat it to earn generous rewards and Guild points!
weeklyEvents.modalUnlockRequirement:
Server Day 2
Reach Lv.30 to unlock

weeklyEvents.title: Mimic Chest
weeklyEvents.description: Every Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday, from 8:00 to 23:00, Mimic Chests will spawn in the wild every hour and at the 30-minute mark, lasting 20 minutes. Adventurers can challenge solo or in a party to earn generous rewards!

weeklyEvents.title: Mirror World
weeklyEvents.description: Head to the Guild to enter Mirror World and complete challenges!

weeklyEvents.title: Training Dummy Challenge
weeklyEvents.description: Training Dummy Challenge is open all day. Adventurers can choose between a timed damage challenge or a solo MVP challenge. The latter unlocks after the 2nd Job Change.

weeklyEvents.title: Bounty Hunt
weeklyEvents.description: Every Monday from 12:00 until 5:00 the next day, participate in the event to challenge monsters and earn rewards!

weeklyEvents.title: Hazy Forest
weeklyEvents.description: This treasure-filled forest is fraught with danger, with adventurers on the prowl. It's time to claim your loot!

weeklyEvents.title: Ancient Ruins
weeklyEvents.description: Registration opens 15 minutes before the event starts. Unregistered players cannot participate. The event map consists of three floors. Find the key to advance to the next. Defeat monsters or rival players holding keys to claim them.

weeklyEvents.title: Guild Banquet
weeklyEvents.description: Join the quiz and share a feast with your Guildmates!

weeklyEvents.title: Clash of The Chosen
weeklyEvents.description: The competitive event, Clash of the Chosen, is about to begin! Compete against the strongest players in your Class—only the mightiest will be crowned with the supreme title of the Chosen One.

weeklyEvents.title: Guild League
weeklyEvents.description: An epic war beckons! Clash in grand guild battles through the Preliminaries, Semi-Finals, and Finals to claim the crown. Massive loot awaits, and auction dividends will be shared among all brave participants!

weeklyEvents.title: Luminous Vale
weeklyEvents.description: During the event, explore Luminous Vale where monsters keep respawning and players can freely engage in PVP!

weeklyEvents.title: War of Kings
weeklyEvents.description: The war horn has sounded! Which Adventurer Party will claim the final crown? Let's wait and see!Note: You must enter the Lounge in a Party for War of Kings. Party size is unlimited, but you cannot have more than 2 Adventurers from the same 2nd Job branch

weeklyEvents.description: Cross-server war begins! Fight for the peak! Who will become the final king's Party? Let's wait and see! Note: A Party cannot have more than 2 adventurers from the same 2nd Job branch.

weeklyEvents.title: War of Kings Registration
weeklyEvents.description: Registration for War of Kings opens at 10:00 on Monday of the fourth week each month and closes at 12:59 on Saturday of the fourth week. Registration will not be available after the deadline, and unregistered adventurers cannot participate in the event. Note: A Party cannot have more than 2 adventurers from the same 2nd Job branch.
